chunks: Zakariyyā ibn Ādam asked Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about water birds, and he said:
"If it picks up other than filth, then there is no harm in it."

key_terms.الْمَاءِ: of the water; referring to aquatic or water-dwelling birds
key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression of permissibility
key_terms.يَلْتَقِطُ: picks up or pecks at food

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on eating water birds that do not feed on filth?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning water birds. The Imam عليه السلام states that if such birds do not pick at filth, then there is no harm in them, indicating permissibility in this context.
